answer.summary: Establish a bounded research inquiry focused on verifying explicitly reported decay or retention rates in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 before advancing to memory persistence analysis under periodic input and perturbations.
answer.content: The brief requires extraction and verification of a single, numerically specified decay rate or time-based retention percentage from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1. If no such data exists, the research question must shift to the minimum duration of periodic input needed for observable memory persistence, strictly anchored in the same source. Acceptance criteria: either a verifiable retention metric is identified or a distinct, data-grounded research question is formulated based on explicit source content without inference or assumption. No external data or extrapolation is permitted.

answer.lesson: All memory research must verify the presence of explicitly reported, numerically specified retention metrics in primary sources before any empirical inquiry can proceed; absence of such data renders the research untestable and invalid.
